title: This T-Shirt Is Too Big
summary: Siswa belajar mendeskripsikan pakaian (ukuran, warna, motif), memberi alasan dengan too/enough, dan menanyakan harga dengan How much does/do … cost?
content:
## Tujuan Belajar

• Menyebutkan dan mendeskripsikan pakaian berdasarkan ukuran, warna, dan motif.
• Memberi alasan mengapa pakaian cocok atau tidak cocok (too big, long enough).
• Membeli pakaian dan menanyakan harga dengan "How much …?".

## Kosakata Inti

Kosakata unit ini adalah nama pakaian (hoodie, school uniform, jacket, T-shirt, pants, skirt, dress, shorts, socks, jeans, shirt) dan kata sifat untuk mendeskripsikannya: ukuran (big, small, loose, long, short), motif (checked = kotak-kotak, spotted = totol-totol, striped = bergaris, floral = motif bunga), dan warna (light = muda/terang, dark = tua/gelap). Contoh:

I wear my school uniform from Monday to Thursday.
This checked hoodie is warm and comfortable.
My sister has a long floral skirt and a pretty dress.

## Tata Bahasa: How much does/do … cost? & too / enough

Untuk menanyakan harga, pakai pola: How much + does/do + benda + cost?
does → untuk satu benda (the jacket, this T-shirt)
do → untuk benda jamak atau berpasangan (the shoes, these pants, jeans, socks)

Jawabannya: The + benda + costs/cost + harga. Benda tunggal memakai "costs", benda jamak memakai "cost". Di dalam pertanyaan, "cost" selalu bentuk dasar (tanpa -s). Untuk memberi alasan, pakai too + kata sifat (ada masalah: too big) atau kata sifat + enough (sudah cukup/pas: long enough).

How much does the yellow jacket cost?
The yellow jacket costs $24.99.
How much do these striped socks cost?
The striped socks cost $5.99.
This T-shirt is too big for me.
The dress is long enough.

## Contoh Percakapan

Seller: Good morning! Can I help you?
Nadia: Yes, please. How much does this checked hoodie cost?
Seller: It costs $18.99.
Nadia: Hmm, I think it's too big. Do you have a small one?
Seller: Yes, here you are. Try it on.
Nadia: It's big enough and very comfortable. I like it!
Nadia: And how much do these athletic shorts cost?
Seller: They cost $12.99.
Nadia: Great. I'll take the hoodie and the shorts, please.

## Ayo Berlatih

What are you wearing today?
Contoh: I'm wearing my school uniform and black shoes.

Do you like checked shirts? Why or why not?
Contoh: Yes, I do. I think they look cool and comfortable.

How much does your favorite T-shirt cost?
Contoh: My favorite T-shirt costs $10.99.

Are your old shoes too small for you now?
Contoh: Yes, they are. They are too small for my feet.

## Tips

• Ingat pasangannya: does + benda tunggal, do + benda jamak. Pants, jeans, shorts, dan socks selalu dianggap jamak.

• Saat melihat toko (atau toko online), latih dirimu menyebut harga dalam bahasa Inggris, misalnya "The jeans cost $25.99." dan "This shirt is too long for me."

questions.q: Why does Mia need a new jacket?
questions.passage: Mia needs a new jacket for winter because her old one is too small. On Saturday, she goes to a clothing store with her dad. First, she tries on a light green jacket, but it is too small. Then she tries on a dark blue jacket. It fits well and feels warm and comfortable. Mia also tries on a pair of big shoes, but they are too big, so she puts them back. She asks the worker, "How much does this jacket cost?" The worker smiles and says, "It costs thirty dollars." Mia's dad buys the jacket for her. She is happy and wears it home because she likes it so much.

Because her old jacket is too small.
Because she wants a jacket for school.
Because her old jacket is too dark.

notes: PERLU DICEK GURU: Part 2A no. 5 "How much does / do these striped socks cost?" — PDF ANSWER melingkari "does" (sudah diperbesar untuk memastikan). Secara tata bahasa yang benar adalah "do" (these striped socks = jamak; lihat juga Language Tips TG: plural → do … cost). Mengikuti brief, kunci di JSON tetap mengikuti PDF (answer = "does"), tetapi sebaiknya diganti ke "do" (answer: 1). Part 1B no. 1 "I wear my _____ when it rains.": kunci PDF "umbrella"; "spotted umbrella" juga masuk akal tetapi dipakai di no. 9, jadi hanya "umbrella" yang diterima. Part 2B (unscramble) dijadikan FILL_IN dengan kalimat utuh; diterima juga tanpa tanda baca akhir (pencocokan tidak peka huruf besar/kecil). Part 3 aslinya menjawab dengan kalimat lengkap (jawaban bebas); karena pencocokan isian harus persis sama, diubah menjadi READING MC dengan opsi kalimat lengkap — opsi benar = kalimat kunci PDF (Because her old jacket is too small. / It is too small. / Because they are too big for her feet. / It costs thirty dollars. / She feels happy.). Kata "umbrella" di kotak kata tidak termasuk Key Vocabulary TG sehingga tidak dimasukkan ke vocabulary. | DIKOREKSI: Part 2A no. 5 memakai 'do' (subjek jamak), bukan 'does' seperti di PDF.
